🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange – Visit to Escuela Técnica N.º 16 “España”

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange to Argentina, the RFE delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, visited **Escuela Técnica N.º 16 “España”** in Argentina, gaining valuable insight into the country’s approach to technical and vocational education.

The school offers students practical training across diverse disciplines, including optics, carpentry, electrical studies, computer science and sensor technology. The combination of classroom learning with hands-on technical skills equips students with knowledge and practical abilities relevant to today’s employment market.

A particularly touching highlight of the visit was the warm welcome extended to the Indian delegation. The school prepared a special welcome note in Hindi, demonstrating the thoughtfulness and cultural warmth of the teachers and students and immediately creating a beautiful connection between India and Argentina.

The RFE delegates had an opportunity to interact with the students and teachers, understand their training programmes and witness the commitment of the faculty towards developing skilled and confident young professionals.

The school’s focus goes beyond education—it is about empowering young people with employable skills, preparing them for the job market and enabling them to become financially independent and stand on their own feet.

The visit was an enriching learning experience for the delegation and a wonderful example of how education, vocational training and skill development can transform lives and strengthen communities.

Skills • Education • Empowerment • Independence

The visit beautifully reflected the spirit of the Rotary Friendship Exchange—learning from each other, sharing experiences and building meaningful connections between District 3141 and District 4895.
